title: Prepare Us, Lord, to View Thy Cross
description: Prepare Us, Lord, to View Thy Cross in Tonic Solfa to ST. AGNES, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 2 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 675 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Before Communion”, where the book credits them to Pratt's Collection.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. AGNES; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Pre-pare us, Lord, to view thy cross, Who all our griefs hast borne; To look on thee, whom we have pierced, To look on thee, and mourn.

lines: Prepare us, Lord, to view thy cross,
Who all our griefs hast borne;
To look on thee, whom we have pierced, —
To look on thee, and mourn.
While thus we mourn we would rejoice;
And, as thy cross we see,
Let each exclaim in faith and hope,

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ST. AGNES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
